§6Thorium Fuel

§aCheap, self-breeding, and the safest RBMK fuel in the game.

§bThorium Fuel§f is a 2:1 mix of Th-232 (fertile) and U-233 (fissile). One of the weakest fuels, but breeds more fissile material than it consumes.

§6Production§f:
• §bBreeding Reactor§f: Th-232 quad rod at §e1,500§f flux → thorium fuel
• §bManual§f: 2 U-233 nuggets + 4 Th-232 nuggets → thorium fuel billet (shapeless)

§6ZIRNOX Thorium Fuel§f (§e40 heat/t§f, §e200,000 ticks§f):
Sits between NU and MEU in power. Recycling yields more U-233 than consumed, making it self-sustaining.

§6Breeding Rods (ZIRNOX)§f:
Th-232 → U-233 via neutron activation. No flux/heat until breeding completes. §e20,000 tick§f lifespan.

§6RBMK ThMEU§f: Euler flux function, physically cannot exceed §e20 flux§f output. Boosted slope depletion means it gets stronger as it burns. Excellent for stabilizing dangerous fuels.

§ePS:§f The thorium cycle is renewable. Breed Th-232 in a breeding reactor, process spent rods in SILEX, reinvest the U-233.
